class.name: VAListener
class.brief_description: The point sounds are heard from. Muffling and reverb are raytraced relative to the current listener.
class.description: A [VAWorld] can contain multiple [VAListener] nodes, but only one is current at a time. All listeners in a world share a single raytraced emitter, which follows the current listener's position and uses its settings, so switching listeners doesn't restart raytracing. The first listener added to a world becomes current automatically. A listener added later with [member current] enabled takes over as the current listener. When the current listener leaves the tree, the next listener in the world takes over. For multiplayer games, add a [VAListener] to each player scene with [member current] disabled, then call [method make_current] on the local player's listener.

method.name: make_current
method.description: Makes this the world's current listener. Same as setting [member current] to [code]true[/code].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this is the world's current listener. Setting it to [code]false[/code] hands over to another listener in the world. If this is the only listener, it stays current.
